'''Zakuul fighters''' were a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] type used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].

==History==
During the [[Eternal Empire raids]], in which the [[Eternal Fleet]] did not participate, Zakuul fighters participated in battles such as the [[attack on Korriban]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> After the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] the Eternal Fleet took over the bulk of the naval operations, and as the result the starfighters saw little action during the [[War against Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTFEchapter16" />

[[File:Zakuul_fighter_above_Odessen.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Alliance Commander pilots a Zakuul fighter above Odessen.]]
Several Zakuul fighters were deployed aboard [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]]'s [[Eternal Flagship]]. During the [[Battle of Odessen]] the [[Alliance Commander]] commandeered one of these fighters to escape the Flagship before its impending destruction.<ref name="KOTFEchapter16" /> After the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] victory over [[Zakuul]], some of Zakuul fighters fell into its hands and were incorporated into the [[Eternal Alliance fleet]]. The Commander and [[Theron Shan]] used one such fighter to travel to [[Iokath]] during the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="Iokath" />
